notes.title: The Ritual is Broken. Forbidden Offering is OUT NOW
notes.content: [p]The altar is cold. The offering was refused.[/p][p]They demanded a soul to quiet the encroaching Void. A simple sacrifice to preserve a dying world. You were given one choice, and you chose [b]defiance[/b].[/p][p]The ritual is broken. The pact is shattered. And the price for your love is the world's damnation.[/p][p]Today, the consequences of that choice are unleashed. [b]Forbidden Offering is OUT NOW on Steam.[/b][/p][p]This is not a story of a dark bargain, but of the terrifying cost of breaking one. The slaughter you will unleash is not for power, but for survival. The endless hordes are not a trial; they are the wrath of a cosmos you have spurned.[/p][p][/p][p]To all of you who have followed our whispers and held your breath in anticipation—we thank you. The vigil is over. The true fight begins now.[/p][p]Step into the chaos you have wrought.[/p][p][/p][p]You chose one life over all others. Now you must fight to prove it was worth it.[/p][p][/p][p]— Binah Games.[/p]

notes.title: The Ritual Begins... A Glimpse of Forbidden Offering Has Escaped.
notes.content:
The whispers are true. It's... out.

I am Vasily from Binah Games, and what began as a creative endeavor has taken a darker turn. After nights that felt less like work and more like a descent, [b]the playable demo for my game, Forbidden Offering, has clawed its way onto Steam[/b]. I'm not sure if "share" is the right word; perhaps "unleash" is more fitting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136577/eb1f0d9421ce85c4d85c099c15f804084aee6678.png[/img]

This demo is not a gentle invitation. It is a sliver of the ordeal, offering you a chance to:
[list]
[*]Feel the oppressive weight of the core loop, the endless struggle. Balance is not fair.
[*]Witness fragments of a story already steeped in shadow.
[*]Truly understand what it means to "survive the ordeal"... or if such a thing is even possible.
[/list]

There's a part of me that hesitates, that wants to warn you away.
If you dare to look into the abyss, if you feel an irresistible pull towards the forbidden:

Confront the Forbidden Offering Demo [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3067680/Forbidden_Offering]Here[/url]

And if... if this darkness resonates within you, if you wish to witness the full unfolding of this grim fate, then [b]etch your mark upon the Wishlist[/b]. It serves as a beacon, ensuring you won't miss the final descent.

May you find... something... in this doomed world.

You can also leave feedback on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3067680/discussions/]forums[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/pveyuzhUam]Discord[/url].
